source_doc.title: Zacks: AAOI Bets on 800G Ramp, 1.6T Optics & Texas Scale to Power AI Growth
source_doc.permission_basis: Copyrighted analyst commentary; only brief quotations for research are stored in library/raw and this extraction.

sources.quote: 800 gigabits per second transceivers to become the largest individual data center revenue line beginning in the second quarter of 2026, with 1.6 terabits per second contributing later in 2026
By year-end 2026, AAOI is targeting capability of more than 500,000 pieces per month across 800 gigabits per second and 1.6 terabits per second combined
new 210,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Sugar Land ... more than triple Texas laser capacity by mid-2027

claims.statement: AAOI expects 800G transceivers to become its largest individual data-center revenue line from Q2 2026 (1.6T contributing later in 2026), targeting more than 500,000 combined 800G/1.6T pieces per month capability by year-end 2026.
claims.disproof_condition: Quarterly results show 800G failing to become the largest DC revenue line in 2026, or the 500k/month capability target is pushed out.

claims.statement: AAOI is building a new 210,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in Sugar Land and plans to more than triple Texas laser capacity by mid-2027 — US-based laser capacity expansion.
claims.disproof_condition: The Sugar Land facility or laser capacity expansion is delayed, scaled back, or cancelled.
